title: 第23章 地牢钥匙虎力桩功第24章 金刚庇护刀法显威
slug: 全民高塔开局一个神话天赋
lines: 这儿是【新人秘境】，有着种种利好新人的地方，
可谓一个极为珍贵的机会。
吴语如今有足够的本钱，完全可以把握住这次机会......
猎杀山君！
“既然一切都是山贼大当家设计的，那山君受伤恐怕不是陷阱，村长并未骗我。”
“一头重伤的山君......一旦击杀，爆出的卡片和可能存在的宝箱肯定比大当家好。”
“迷途洞才是这个【新人秘境】最大收获的地方！”
“等拿到最珍贵的宝物，再趁着迷雾到来前赶往撤离点，岂不是肥肥撤离？”
吴语一下子冒出了许多想法。
回过神，他按捺下激动，拿出了《虎力桩》和【地牢钥匙】。
地牢钥匙平平无奇，没什么特殊的地方。
而整个恶虎山寨吴语也转了一遍，也未有什么地牢。
吴语略一回忆，低头翻了几页。
在其中几条信息上，记载了山贼大当家前往迷途洞送“血食”。
“第五十一天，山寨里没地方放那些抓来的商队和路人，看来得安置在迷途洞那边。”
“第七十七天，山君不喜拥挤，让我们又耗费了好多力气才在洞内安置好那些血食。也好，这样山君会失去警惕心！”
“看来，地牢就在迷途洞中！”
吴语若有所思，将【地牢钥匙】放回物品栏。
随后，
他看向《虎力桩》，直接捏碎！
卡片化为光点散开，又涌进他的身体中。
一刹那，吴语恍惚间成为了一个山贼。
每日早起苦练《虎力桩功》，为成为超凡武者，当上小头目而努力。
苦练八年后，他终于桩功入门，一身气血逐渐显露出神异，开始远超常人！
等回过神的时候，吴语脑海中的记忆逐渐模糊，只有关于《虎力桩》这门桩功的修炼记忆还存留。
他起身感受了一下身体，发现果然更壮实了一些，
肌肉鼓起，浑身有力！
“又增强了一次，也不知道我现在的力气有多大，能不能和于铁柱的【九牛之力】相比？”
他有些好奇，随手将一把劣质砍刀拿了出来，
五指稍一用力，刀刃便被扭曲出一个夸张的弧度。
content_en:
This is the [Secret Realm for Newcomers], with all kinds of benefits for newcomers.
It can be described as an extremely precious opportunity.
Wu Yu now has enough capital to seize this opportunity...
Hunt the tiger!
"Since everything was designed by the bandit leader, I'm afraid the tiger's injury was not a trap. The village chief did not lie to me."
"A seriously injured tiger... once killed, the cards that will be exploded and the possible treasure chests will definitely be better than the boss."
"The Lost Cave is the most rewarding place in this [Secret Realm for Newcomers]!"
"Waiting to get the most precious treasure, and then rushing to the evacuation point before the fog arrives, wouldn't it be a fat evacuation?"
Wu Yu suddenly had many ideas.
After coming back to his senses, he suppressed his excitement and took out the "Tiger Power Stake" and the "Dungeon Key".
The dungeon keys are bland and nothing special.
Wu Yu also went through the entire Evil Tiger Cottage and found no dungeons.
"It seems..."
Wu Yu recalled briefly, then lowered his head and turned a few pages.
Several of the messages recorded that the bandit leader went to the Lost Cave to deliver "blood food".
...
"On the fifty-first day, there is no place in the village to put the captured caravans and passers-by. It seems that they have to be placed over there in the Lost Cave."
...
"On the seventy-seventh day, the tiger doesn't like crowds, so we spent a lot of effort to place the blood food in the cave. It's good, this way the tiger will lose his vigilance!"
...
"It seems that the dungeon is in the Lost Cave!"
Wu Yu was thoughtful and put the [Dungeon Key] back in the inventory.
Subsequently,
He looked at the "Tiger Power Stake" and crushed it directly!
The card turned into light spots and dispersed, then poured into his body.
In an instant, Wu Yu suddenly became a bandit.
Get up early every day and practice "Tiger Power Stake Kung Fu" hard, working hard to become an extraordinary warrior and a small boss.
After eight years of hard training, he finally got started with Zhuang Kung Fu, and his energy and blood gradually showed miraculous powers, and he began to far surpass ordinary people!
When Wu Yu came back to his senses, the memories in Wu Yu's mind gradually became blurred, and only the memory of practicing the "Tiger Power Stake" skill remained.
He stood up and felt his body, and found that he was indeed stronger.
The muscles are bulging and the whole body is strong!
"It's been strengthened again. I don't know how strong I am now. Can it be compared with Yu Tiezhu's [Power of Nine Bulls]?"
He was a little curious and took out a low-quality machete.
With a little force from the five fingers, the blade was twisted into an exaggerated arc.
title_en: Chapter 23 Dungeon Key Tiger Power Pile Kung Fu Chapter 24 King Kong Shelter Sword Technique Demonstrates Power
